pages.name: General

pages.name: Survival Unlocks
pages.summary: Each toggle: OFF mirrors vanilla Survival, ON applies the tweak.

pages.name: Survival
pages.summary: Toggles for the vanilla Survival hardcore-rule systems (food/water and sleep deprivation). Save and reload after toggling so the script picks up the new state immediately; otherwise the change takes effect on the next in-game tick (within a few in-game minutes).

content.text: Toggles for the vanilla Survival hardcore-rule systems (food/water and sleep deprivation). Save and reload after toggling so the script picks up the new state immediately; otherwise the change takes effect on the next in-game tick (within a few in-game minutes).
Implemented sliders multiply proven vanilla magnitudes. 1.00 = vanilla; see each setting for caveats.
Per-difficulty multipliers applied as baseline * value. 1.00 = vanilla. Survival here is the current TSV difficulty.

Action Points, sprint, carry weight, and health. Multiplier sliders show 1.00 = vanilla; Direct sliders use the vanilla default as neutral. Formula sliders (AP Pool, AP per Agility, Carry, Health per Endurance/Level) edit the actor-value formula. Your current derived value will refresh on the next level-up, equip change, fast-travel, or save reload.

ui.label: Enable Plugin
ui.help: Master switch for gameplay tweaks. Diagnostics can still run while disabled.

ui.label: Allow Console
ui.help: ON re-enables the developer console while in Survival.

ui.label: Allow Fast Travel
ui.help: ON allows Pip-Boy fast travel in Survival. Fast-travel loads get targeted protection.

ui.label: Allow God Mode
ui.help: ON lets tgm and tim console cheats work in Survival.

ui.label: Allow Auto-Saves
ui.help: ON allows queued vanilla auto-saves in Survival.

ui.label: Allow Manual Saves

ui.label: Show Enemies on Compass
ui.help: ON restores vanilla red-dot enemy markers on the compass.

ui.label: Show Locations on Compass

ui.label: Remove Chem/Aid Weight
ui.help: ON strips Survival's added weight from consumables (chems, stimpaks, food).

ui.label: Remove Ammo Weight
ui.help: ON strips Survival's added weight from ammunition.

ui.label: Remove Survival Carry-Weight Penalty
ui.help: ON neutralizes Survival's -100 carry-weight ability for player and companions. Save and reload after toggling for the change to take effect on already-applied characters.

ui.label: Allow Re-entering Survival
ui.help: ON lets you turn Survival back on after leaving it.

ui.label: Keep Exit Save
ui.help: ON keeps the exit save on load. Toggle OFF to delete it from the load menu.
